summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container. Changes: sparql.py adds the Update class (prologue, algebra) beside Query; algebra.py translateUpdate always returns an Update, building the prologue from the single declaration group on the empty path before the early return; update.py evalUpdate iterates update.algebra; processor.py adds prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) with _original_args, mirroring prepareQuery; __init__.py exports prepareUpdate; test/test_sparql_prepare.py adds 13 tests covering the required behaviours. Nothing was run: tests, test_dawg, and black were not executed, so all verification is by reading. Nothing was committed.
